release_name: Command Center + Watch Areas + Corridor Explorer
new_features: Interactive Command Center coverage explorer with domain sub-searches and direct workspace shortcuts
Dedicated Watch Areas view for Monitoring, Disruption Watch, External Disruptions and Weather/Labour
Dedicated Corridors & Hubs view for chokepoints, multimodal corridors, dry ports, economic zones and logistics networks
Persistent in-session PortWatch and Hormuz API results across Streamlit reruns
Persistent Live Feeds view selection instead of reset-prone tabs
changes: Reworked Connected Coverage from passive cards into searchable coverage tabs with direct navigation.
Added visible quick access to Vessels, Sanctions, Watch Areas, Corridors & Hubs and PortWatch from the Command Center.
Promoted monitoring/watch data and corridor/inland-hub data to first-class views.
Retained last successful PortWatch and Hormuz live responses in session state so data does not disappear on rerun or temporary refresh failure.
Preserved all canonical Excel workbooks unchanged.
